title: Aliens take people to build a critical mass

tellings.quote: I also ask them why they take some people like they took me and tomorrow they might take you and so on.

plain: A guest presented on Jesse Michels' podcast as the president of a Russian republic says aliens took him in 1997. He says he asked them why they take some people, like him, and might take anyone else tomorrow. As the story is framed, the answer was that they are building up a critical mass of people, which would mean the abductions follow a deliberate plan.
